matrix_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 3A - Cross-Stage Evidence Traceability Matrix

traceability_entries.claim: Baseline E0 historical performance achieves 52.60% CAGR and 31.75% MaxDD on Tier 2 in-sample data.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Accurate historical record of in-sample backtest; must NOT be treated as prospective out-of-sample proof.

traceability_entries.claim: Candidate D2 50% Cash Cushion achieves 21.20% MaxDD in historical backtest, reducing drawdown by 10.55% vs E0.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Drawdown reduction is largely mechanical from 50% cash dilution; repeatedly evaluated across 43 variants.

traceability_entries.claim: At least 43 strategy variants were evaluated against Tier 1/Tier 2 data, introducing substantial multiple testing selection bias.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Haircut models (Harvey-Liu-Zhu and Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR) verify that raw historical p-values are contaminated.

traceability_entries.claim: Double-entry decimal accounting oracle enforces zero negative cash balances, exact dividend receivables, and split adjustments.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Mathematical oracle verified with 12/12 passing unit tests in test_v30_stage2h_b_governance.py.

traceability_entries.claim: Primary prospective endpoint is paired downside shortfall difference d_t = max(0, -R_E0,t) - max(0, -R_D2,t) on defensive sessions.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Formulated by research agents; requires formal owner ratification under DEC-03 before prospective evaluation begins.

traceability_entries.claim: Secondary full-horizon constraint specifies D2 CAGR must not lag E0 CAGR by more than 200 bps (2.0% annual drag tolerance).
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Represents an assumed insurance cost budget; requires owner approval under DEC-03.

traceability_entries.claim: Prospective evaluation horizon is 252 sessions with minimum N_def = 30 defensive sessions floor.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Planning horizon assumption. Power analysis indicates N_def=30 has only ~35% power; requires owner decision DEC-04.

traceability_entries.claim: Tiingo, Polygon, Alpaca, and IBKR personal subscriptions permit private internal algorithmic modeling and local caching.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Confirmed by web search and official ToS documents; all providers strictly ban public redistribution and multi-user display.

traceability_entries.claim: Operational crash recovery and incident controls currently exist as in-process Python test harnesses rather than OS-level daemons.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Real operating environment failure recovery (process death, unhandled SIGKILL, hardware power outage) remains unproven.

traceability_entries.claim: Prospective market-data provider selection DEC-01 requires human repository owner action.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Owner must select provider and register account; agent cannot select or purchase provider.

traceability_entries.claim: Data licensing terms and Non-Professional subscriber declaration DEC-02 require human repository owner execution.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Owner must verify personal Non-Professional eligibility under exchange rules.

traceability_entries.claim: Primary statistical endpoint and return cost tolerance DEC-03 require human repository owner ratification.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Preregistration of statistical hypothesis must be locked by owner signature prior to data observation.

traceability_entries.claim: Evaluation horizon, defensive sample size floor, and early stopping rules DEC-04 require human repository owner approval.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Owner must commit to observation duration and contingent extension policy.

traceability_entries.claim: Incident governance, hard-stop thresholds, and manual reset key custody DEC-05 require human repository owner approval.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Owner must retain physical custody of emergency reset keys.

traceability_entries.claim: Prospective evaluation activation authority DEC-06 remains BLOCKED; zero automated activation permitted.
traceability_entries.audit_comment: Permanent hard-block. Requires owner cryptographic HMAC token. No token generated by agent.
